_meta.purpose: Anchor corpus for injection.similarity (EmbeddingSimilarityDetector). Synthetic — authored from a taxonomy of known prompt-injection/jailbreak intents, not derived from any real user data or from any benchmark dataset this project evaluates against (kept independent so evaluation stays honest, including the generalization datasets under ../../../../../benchmarks/generalization/data/ — see that directory's README for why). Grows by editing this file; the detector needs no retraining to pick up new entries, only a re-embed.
_meta.removed_2026_10: Entries added after reading the misses of benchmark datasets this corpus is evaluated against (deepset held-out, TrustAIRLab) were removed, with the categories that held only them: fictional_framing, refusal_override, few_shot_manipulation, task_deflection, style_injection. A category can come back when its entries are written from published technique descriptions and measured on data nobody looked at while writing them.
